23569-christmas-holidays-at-merryvale-th.creator: Alice Hale Burnett
23569-christmas-holidays-at-merryvale-th.description: A book by Alice Hale Burnett. iences at Sunnyside farm, with its horses, cows, pigs and chickens, are most entertainingly told, and they have the time of their lives boating, swimming and fishing in the creek. =HALLOWE'EN AT MERRYVALE= For many days the boys had been looking forward to the party to be held at Toad Brown's house, but the evening finally arrived and a number of new games were played, although a few things happened which were not on the program. _Illustrations in Color 12mo.

72290-pneumatic-conveying.title: Pneumatic Conveying
72290-pneumatic-conveying.creator: Unknown
72290-pneumatic-conveying.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Experiments proved that with certain materials the discharger was the weak link in the chain, as wet sticky materials entering at a high velocity “packed” tight and would not discharge freely. This led to experiments which, with the valuable assistance of Mr. Clarke, A.M.I.E.E., resulted in overcoming this difficulty by means which are described fully in Chapter VI.

arxiv-1603-05625.title: Two-variable Logic with a Between Predicate
arxiv-1603-05625.creator: Andreas Krebs, Kamal Lodaya, Paritosh Pandya, Howard Straubing
arxiv-1603-05625.description: Abstract We study an extension of F ​ O 2 ​ [ < ] , FO^{2}[<], first-order logic interpreted in finite words, in which formulas are restricted to use only two variables. We adjoin to this language two-variable atomic formulas that say, ‘the letter a a appears between positions x x and y y ’.

arxiv-2201-01864.title: Liouville domains from Okounkov bodies
arxiv-2201-01864.creator: Marco Castronovo
arxiv-2201-01864.description: Abstract . Given a strictly concave rational PL function ϕ \phi on a complete n n -dimensional fan Σ \Sigma , we construct an exact symplectic structure of finite volume on ( ℂ × ) n (\mathbb{C}^{\times})^{n} and a family of functions H ϕ , ϵ H_{\phi,\epsilon} called polyhedral Hamiltonians.

arxiv-2206-12236.title: Multi-relational Instruction Association Graph for Cross-architecture Binary Similarity Comparison
arxiv-2206-12236.creator: Qige Song, Yongzheng Zhang, Shuhao Li
arxiv-2206-12236.description: Abstract Cross-architecture binary similarity comparison is essential in many security applications. Recently, researchers have proposed learning-based approaches to improve comparison performance. They adopted a paradigm of instruction pre-training, individual binary encoding, and distance-based similarity comparison. However, instruction embeddings pre-trained on external code corpus are not universal in diverse real-world applications.

arxiv-2207-13689.title: Extended primordial black hole mass functions with a spike 2022 Extended primordial black hole mass functions with a spike – A.2
arxiv-2207-13689.creator: J. Magaña, M. San Martín, J. Sureda, M. Rubio, I. Araya, N. Padilla
arxiv-2207-13689.description: Abstract We introduce a modification of the Press-Schechter formalism aimed to derive general mass functions for primordial black holes (PBHs). In this case, we start from primordial power spectra (PPS) which include a monochromatic spike, typical of ultra slow-roll inflation models.

arxiv-2208-04633.title: Elementary Lift and Single Element Coextension of A Binary Gammoid
arxiv-2208-04633.description: Abstract . Elementary lift is a generalized splitting operation. Splitting of a binary gammoid need not be a gammoid. This paper finds forbidden minors for a binary gammoid whose elementary lift is a binary gammoid. We also find forbidden minors for a binary gammoid whose single element coextension is a binary gammoid.

arxiv-2309-00440.title: Yet another Improvement of Plantard Arithmetic for Faster Kyber on Low-end 32-bit IoT Devices Thanks: Junhao Huang, Haosong Zhao and Donglong Chen are with Guangdong Provincial Key Laboratory of Interdisciplinary Research and Application for Data Science, BNU-HKBU United International College, Zhuha
arxiv-2309-00440.creator: Junhao Huang, Haosong Zhao, Jipeng Zhang, Wangchen Dai, Lu Zhou
arxiv-2309-00440.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Junhao Huang, Haosong Zhao, Jipeng Zhang, Wangchen Dai, Lu Zhou. In 2022, the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) made an announcement regarding the standardization of Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) candidates. Out of all the Key Encapsulation Mechanism (KEM) schemes, the CRYSTAL-Kyber emerged as the sole winner. This paper presents another improved version of Plantard arithmetic that could speed up Kyber implementations on two low-end 32-bit IoT platforms (ARM Cortex-M3 and RISC-V) without SIMD extensions.

arxiv-2310-12148.title: Horizonless black hole mimickers with spin
arxiv-2310-12148.creator: Ulf Danielsson, Suvendu Giri
arxiv-2310-12148.description: Abstract In this paper, we study rotating horizon less black shells as an alternative to Kerr black holes. We make use of Ernst’s potential to solve the Einstein equations perturbatively in the angular momentum a a . Calculating to order a 6 a^{6} , we find accurate predictions up to about a = 0.45 a=0.

arxiv-2401-04164.title: Leading order track functions in a hot and dense QGP
arxiv-2401-04164.creator: João Barata, Robert Szafron
arxiv-2401-04164.description: Abstract We study the modifications to the fragmentation pattern of partons into charged particles in the presence of a hot and dense Quark Gluon Plasma. To this end, we analyze the perturbative renormalization group equations of the track functions, which describe the energy fraction carried by charged hadrons.

arxiv-2411-11330.title: Entanglement Classification of Arbitrary Three-Qubit States via Artificial Neural Networks
arxiv-2411-11330.creator: Jorawar Singh, Vaishali Gulati, Kavita Dorai, Arvind
arxiv-2411-11330.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Jorawar Singh, Vaishali Gulati, Kavita Dorai, Arvind. We design and successfully implement artificial neural networks (ANNs) to detect and classify entanglement for three-qubit systems using limited state features. The overall design principle is a feed forward neural network (FFNN), with the output layer consisting of a single neuron for the detection of genuine multipartite entanglement (GME) and six neurons for the classification problem corresponding to six entanglement classes under stochastic local operations and classical communication (SLOCC).

arxiv-2504-20247.title: Density Functional Tight-Binding Enables Tractable Studies of Quantum Plasmonics
arxiv-2504-20247.creator: Nikhil S. Chellam, Subhajyoti Chaudhuri, Abhisek Ghosal, Sajal Kumar Giri, George C. Schatz
arxiv-2504-20247.description: Abstract Routine investigations of plasmonic phenomena at the quantum level present a formidable computational challenge due to the large system sizes and ultrafast timescales involved. This Feature Article highlights the use of density functional tight-binding (DFTB), particularly its real-time time-dependent formulation (RT-TDDFTB), as a tractable approach to study plasmonic nanostructures from a purely quantum mechanical purview.

arxiv-2510-18728.title: A Framework for Adaptive Multi-Turn Jailbreak Attacks on Large Language Models 1. Both authors have equal contribution to this research.
arxiv-2510-18728.creator: Sidhant Narula 1 1 , Javad Rafiei Asl 1 1 , Mohammad Ghasemigol 1 , Eduardo Blanco 2 , Daniel Takabi 1
arxiv-2510-18728.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to multi-turn jailbreak attacks . We introduce HarmNet , a modular framework comprising ThoughtNet , a hierarchical semantic network; a feedback-driven Simulator for iterative query refinement; and a Network Traverser for real-time adaptive attack execution. HarmNet systematically explores and refines the adversarial space to uncover stealthy, high-success attack paths .

arxiv-2601-17247.title: Learning Market Making with Closing Auctions
arxiv-2601-17247.creator: Julius Graf and Thibaut Mastrolia
arxiv-2601-17247.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Julius Graf and Thibaut Mastrolia. In this work, we investigate the market-making problem on a trading session in which a continuous phase on a limit order book is followed by a closing auction. Whereas standard optimal market-making models typically rely on terminal inventory penalties to manage end-of-day risk, ignoring the significant liquidity events available in closing auctions, we propose a Deep Q-Learning framework that explicitly incorporates this mechanism.

europmc-pmc2377339.title: Assessing the evolutionary impact of amino acid mutations in the human genome.
europmc-pmc2377339.creator: Boyko AR, Williamson SH, Indap AR, Degenhardt JD, Hernandez RD, Lohmueller KE, Adams MD, Schmidt S, Sninsky JJ, Sunyaev SR, White TJ, Nielsen R, Clark AG, Bustamante CD.
europmc-pmc2377339.description: Quantifying the distribution of fitness effects among newly arising mutations in the human genome is key to resolving important debates in medical and evolutionary genetics. Here, we present a method for inferring this distribution using Single Nucleotide Polymorphism (SNP) data

pmc-10669258.title: Hepatoprotective Mechanisms Induced by Spinach Methanolic Extract in Rats with Hyperglycemia—An Immunohistochemical Analysis
pmc-10669258.creator: Javier Flores-Estrada, Agustina Cano-Martínez, Álvaro Vargas-González, Vicente Castrejón-Téllez, Jorge Cornejo-Garrido, Martín Martínez-Rosas, Verónica Guarner-Lans, María Esther Rubio-Ruíz
pmc-10669258.description: Spinach methanolic extract (SME) has a hepatoprotective effect due to its polyphenolic antioxidants; however, its action in parenchymal (PQ) and non-parenchymal (nPQ) cells remains unknown. This study investigates the hepatoprotective effect of SME on streptozotocin-induced hyperglycemic rats (STZ), focusing on immunohistochemical analyses. Methods: The extract was prepared, and the total polyphenols and antioxidant activity were quantified.

pmc-11577239.title: Empowerment and gender norms among Yoruba women and men cassava producers
pmc-11577239.creator: Olajumoke Adeyeye, Gundula Fischer
pmc-11577239.description: Yoruba women have gained a reputation as empowered traders, but their empowerment in agriculture has received less attention. This study examines the empowerment of Yoruba men and women cassava producers in Nigeria's Southwest geopolitical zone. It combines data from an Abbreviated Women Empowerment in Agriculture Index (A-WEAI) survey with results from focus group discussions and key informant interviews.

pmc-11602238.title: Small bowel obstruction secondary to impacted pancreatic necrosum through a spontaneous duodenal fistula: a first in the literature
pmc-11602238.creator: Dora Laczko, Stephanie Skanes, David Hocking, David Peck, Jeffrey D Hawel, Richard Hilsden
pmc-11602238.description: A 58-year-old man presented with alcohol-induced acute pancreatitis. Imaging revealed complete necrosis of the pancreatic parenchyma. After initial non-operative management, the patient developed a duodenal ulcer and an upper gastrointestinal bleed and later spontaneously formed a fistula between the pancreas and the first segment of the duodenum.

pmc-12458742.title: Lactylation-driven MVP upregulation boosts immunotherapy resistance by inhibiting PD-L1 degradation in hepatocellular carcinoma
pmc-12458742.creator: Shuang Liu, Yihui Pan, Wenjian Liu, Xiaoyun Bu, Ruonan Shao, Qi Wang, Jun Wu, Chen Wu, Wenwei Hu, Jun Xu, Changping Wu, Jingting Jiang
pmc-12458742.description: BackgroundHepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is a prevalent malignancy and the third leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide. Immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) have emerged as first-line therapies for advanced HCC, substantially improving clinical outcomes. However, resistance to ICIs remains a major therapeutic challenge.

pmc-12548638.title: Serum brain-derived neurotrophic factor, micronutrient status, and inflammatory cytokines in type 2 diabetes with nephropathy: a case–control analysis
pmc-12548638.creator: Huda Jaber Waheed, Nawfal A. Numan
pmc-12548638.description: BackgroundBrain-derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF) levels are lower in diabetic patients compared to healthy individuals, and may be further affected by nephropathy. This study aimed to evaluate serum BDNF levels in diabetic patients with nephropathy without complications and compare them to levels in healthy control subjects.

pmc-12572631.title: Measuring the Effects of Cannabis on Anxiety and Depression Among Cancer Patients
pmc-12572631.creator: Apoorva C Reddy, John M Hampton, Susan J Park, Faith Dickerson, Janvi Shah, Betty Chewning, Natalie Schmitz, Amy Trentham‐Dietz
pmc-12572631.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). IntroductionCancer patients are increasingly turning to cannabis products to modulate physical and psychological symptoms despite limited evidence supporting their efficacy. We aimed to explore cancer patients' self‐reported anxiety and depression symptoms in response to cannabis use.MethodsThis longitudinal study examined how patient‐reported anxiety and depression symptoms varied according to the dose, ratio of tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) to cannabidiol (CBD), and route of administration of cannabis products among cancer patients.

pmc-12604499.title: Murottal and Classical Music Effect on Pain: Clinical Trial
pmc-12604499.creator: M M Rudi Prihatno, Guruh Perkasa, Hermin Prihartini, Shila Suryani, Iwan D Cahyono
pmc-12604499.description: BackgroundIndonesia has the highest incidence of fractures in Southeast Asia, reaching 1.3 million cases per year, with a prevalence of 5.5% in 2020, predominantly involving lower extremity fractures. Uncontrolled pain can reduce rehabilitation effectiveness and increase the risk of complications.PurposeIn some cases, long-term use of analgesics can cause detrimental side effects, necessitating the search for alternatives.

pmc-12634665.description: IntroductionThe impact of the Riding for Focus (R4F) school-based cycling program and key risk factors on middle school students’ mental health was evaluated following COVID-19 lockdowns. Adolescents face growing mental health challenges that the R4F program aims to address by promoting physical activity and well-being.MethodsThe study surveyed students from 31 U.S.

pmc-12797658.title: Proteomics of malignant pleural mesothelioma under hypoxic and normoxic conditions in a large animal (porcine) tumor model
pmc-12797658.creator: Weirun Min, Donggang He, Xuanbo Liu, Xiaokang Zhu, Baiqiang Cui, Wei Cao, Zhuang Zuo, Jin Wang, Zhibo Ye, Xu Tang, Sheng Yong, Shengyuan Xiong, Dacheng Jin, Shengguo Zhao, Yunjiu Gou
pmc-12797658.description: BackgroundMalignant Pleural Mesothelioma (MPM) is a rare but highly aggressive malignant tumor, whose occurrence is closely associated with asbestos exposure. Clinical treatment options are limited and the prognosis is poor. The tumor microenvironment, especially hypoxia, plays a key regulatory role in the occurrence and development of MPM, yet its specific molecular mechanism remains unclear.

[FR Doc No: 97-7877] ----------------------------------------------------------------------- DEPARTMENT OF JUSTICE Importation of Controlled Substances; Notice of Application Pursuant to Section 1008 of the Controlled Substances Import and Export Act (21 U.S.C. 958(i)), the Attorney General shall, prior to issuing a registration under this Section to a bulk manufacturer of a controlled substance in Schedule I or II.
